link.note: Not John's ancestor: the tree made her Grazia Di Marino's mother, but Grazia's 1916 death act names Caterina di Leo. A 1855 marriage index names her as mother of Concetta di Marino, so she was probably Gaetano's earlier wife (probable). Her own parents are tree-only.

summary: Probably the first wife of John's 4th great-grandfather Gaetano di Marino; NOT John's ancestor (tree error corrected in Round 3).
bio: Tree: Maria d'Ambrosio (Deceased), wife of Gaetano di Marino and mother of Grazia; parents Giuseppe D'Ambrosio (1761-1841) + Maddalena Gialanella (1764-1824). Round 2: conflict with FS (Caterina di Leo). Round 3: Grazia's death act confirms Caterina di Leo; marriage index 1855 #23 lists Giuseppe Petriello (son of Carmine and Maria Marra) marrying Concetta [di] Marino, daughter of Gaetano and Maria d'Ambrosio, 26 Dec 1855. Probable: Gaetano married first Maria d'Ambrosio, then Caterina di Leo. Her parents and the D'Ambrosio/Gialanella/Giordano/Di Vivo/Parisi pedigree are therefore not in John's direct line.
